subject: Post-demo: security intake & SIG/CAIQ route — next steps
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Dec 2025 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: security intake & SIG/CAIQ route — next steps

Hi Alex — thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and ask to keep momentum on the security side so we can scope an onboarding plan: 

Summary from our call:
- BrightPath plan: POC with 2M monthly inference tokens, US customers initially; potential EU customers in Q3.
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 status, data residency for EU expansion, HIPAA applicability (we heard some PHI may be ingested via integrations).
- Team: you (BrightPath) security + product; we (Redwood) will engage security + solutions.

Recommended path (one of the following) — please confirm which you'd prefer:
1) SIG (Standardized Information Gathering) + evidence bundle: good when you want a complete questionnaire answered and SOC 2 artifacts.
2) CAIQ (cloud-focused) only: faster if BrightPath just needs a cloud control view and not full evidence.
3) Custom short-form: we draft 8 targeted questions (HIPAA, residency, encryption, SOC 2 scope) if you prefer a lightweight kickoff.

Action items for BrightPath:
- Confirm preferred questionnaire route (SIG / CAIQ / Custom short-form) — reply to this thread.
- If available, send a SOC 2 summary and any current reports (we can accept a SOC 2 summary PDF).
- Clarify whether customer data will include PHI and whether EU data residency is required for the POC.

I've attached the post-call notes and our SOC 2 intake checklist to speed things up. Once we have your preference I'll loop in Marissa (security) to request evidence and set a target turnaround.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min follow-up if helpful.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
loganw@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: 20251209-demo-postcall-notes.pdf (text), redwood-soc2-intake-checklist.pdf (text)

From: Alex Nguyen <alex@brightpath.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPath Security <security@brightpath.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Dec 2025 09:11:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security intake & SIG/CAIQ route — next steps

Thanks Logan — great session. Quick answers below: 

- Route: We'd prefer SIG this time. Our procurement/security team likes seeing the full questionnaire up front.
- SOC 2: We completed type II in Aug 2024. I'll attach a one-page summary (we redact tester names) and can share the full report under an NDA if needed.
- PHI: For the POC we will not send PHI, but a downstream integration later this year might. For now mark HIPAA as "possible future scope" — not in-scope for the initial POC.
- EU residency: At launch we do not require EU residency, but this is a likely requirement for a specific customer in Q3.

Request: Can Redwood indicate the typical evidence set you ask for with SIG? That helps our security ops triage. Also — do you have an expected turnaround target for the initial SIG responses?

I'll attach the SOC2 summary and a high-level network diagram.

— Alex
Alex Nguyen
Head of Product Security, BrightPath Analytics
alex@brightpath.ai

Attachments: brightpath-soc2-summary.pdf, brightpath-network-diagram.png

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@brightpath.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Dec 2025 11:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security intake & SIG/CAIQ route — next steps

Hi Alex — thanks for the quick reply and for sharing the SOC 2 summary. A couple of clarifying questions from Redwood security before we kick the SIG: 

1) SOC 2 scope: is the Type II report scoped to the production inference service (i.e., the environment that would host BrightPath traffic), or is it narrower? If it's not production-scoped we'll need the specific control mappings for infra and app.

2) Evidence lane: For SIG we typically ask for the following initial artifacts (we only request more if gaps appear):
   - SOC 2 summary + control mapping (if available)
   - Network diagram (you mentioned you attached this)
   - Encryption at-rest and in-transit summary (algorithms and KMS provider)
   - Access control policy excerpt (SSO + SCIM where used)
   - Incident response contact + last tabletop date

3) Doc sharing: We can accept the full SOC 2 under an NDA. If you prefer, we can start with the redacted PDF and request the full report later.

Turnaround: our typical SIG response time is 7–10 business days once we have the bundle and an assigned evidence owner on your side. If BrightPath can field a single security contact to assemble artifacts, we can hit the faster end.

Priyom — assigning you to capture any product/integration-level questions and to coordinate the drive folder.

Thanks — I can jump on a short call with Alex's security ops if that would speed decisions.

— Marissa Cole
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Dec 2025 09:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security intake & SIG/CAIQ route — next steps

Perfect — thanks for confirming SIG and for the SOC 2 summary, Alex. Agreed next steps and owners: 

- BrightPath (Alex / security@brightpath.ai): drop the SOC 2 summary + network diagram into the shared drive link (or send NDA'd full report if you prefer). Target: by EOD Friday, Dec 12.
- Redwood (Marissa): prepare SIG questionnaire and an evidence checklist template; aim to share within 24 business hours of receiving the artifacts.
- Redwood (Priyom): set up a shared drive folder and a short intake doc (ownership + deadlines). I'll send calendar invites for a 30-min intake meeting next week (Mon or Tue morning PST) — please share availability.

If EU residency becomes required for the POC we'll follow our EU data-hosting path (can provide TCO impact in that follow-up).

Thanks — I'll track this as deal BR-3421 in HubSpot and mark security intake as the current milestone.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
